headline: 9 Of 11 Sectors Rise Friday As Real Estate Leads
summary: Nine of 11 sectors are higher in Friday's regular session, with the top three split across defensive, growth and cyclical groups. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single gap clearly standing apart from the other breaks across the table.

headline: 5 Monthly Dividend Stocks That Could Turn Your Portfolio Into a Second Paycheck
summary: Some dividends are backed by nothing more than last quarter's earnings, but a handful of companies collect rent, regulated utility bills, and trash pickup fees under contracts that make next year's cash flow visible before the year even begins.

headline: Kevin Mahn: Comfort Systems is a 'picks-and-shovels play'
summary: Kevin Mahn, Hennion and Walsh Asset Management CIO, joins 'The Exchange' to discuss why there's life left in the bull market if you know where to look.

headline: Is American Electric Power’s Dividend Built to Survive the Data Center Buildout
summary: AEP is borrowing heavily and selling stock to fund a $78 billion buildout for data center demand, all while its dividend raise pace quietly shrinks. Whether that combination protects income investors or sets them up for disappointment depends on four risks few are talking about.

headline: 9 Of 11 Sectors Rise In Tuesday Trading As Defensives Lead
summary: Nine of 11 sectors are higher in Tuesday’s regular session, with defensive sectors holding two of the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with Utilities well ahead of the next group.

headline: Nasdaq 100 Records Have Rarely Been This Narrow, 55 Stocks Are Still Below 50-Day Average
summary: The Nasdaq 100 trades at records Monday, yet 55 of its 101 stocks sit below their 50-day average. QQQ has beaten equal-weight QQQE by 8% since late July.

headline: WULF Stock Dips After TeraWulf Doubles Muskie Data Campus Power Capacity To 1GW
summary: Kentucky Power said TeraWulf will fund $100 million in winter bill credits for residential customers over the first 10 years.

headline: TeraWulf Says Customer Interest Is ‘Tremendous’ As Kentucky Campus Power Doubles
summary: TeraWulf (WULF) stock dropped 5% despite “tremendous” interest in its Muskie campus doubling capacity to 1 GW. Get the full breakdown.

headline: Kentucky Power, TeraWulf Finalize Expanded Agreement Providing for $100 Million in Customer Benefits
summary: Kentucky Power has finalized an amended agreement that would double its contracted electric demand with TeraWulf Inc. (Nasdaq: WULF) while delivering significant long-term benefits for customers and communities across eastern Kentucky.

headline: 8 Of 11 Sectors Rise In Monday Trading As Leaders Split
summary: Eight sectors are higher and three are lower in Monday's regular session, with growth, cyclical and defensive sectors split across the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered.
